say:1:1530204501:0.text: Just enough for the people here in Mirehold.
say:1:1530204501:0.source_cn: 只是水泽营地里这些人的话，勉强也够。
say:1:1530204501:0.male: Just enough for the people here in Mirehold.
say:1:1530204501:0.female: Just enough for the people here in Mirehold.

say:2:1530204502:0.text: But the Halians are stationed here too. They take a huge share of every hunt. It's infuriating!
say:2:1530204502:0.source_cn: 但是呼临人都驻扎在这里，他们还要分走猎物里的一大部分…...
say:2:1530204502:0.male: But the Halians are stationed here too. They take a huge share of every hunt. It's infuriating!
say:2:1530204502:0.female: But the Halians are stationed here too. They take a huge share of every hunt. It's infuriating!

say:3:1530204503:0.text: If I didn't have to worry about my mom, I'd have punched them already!
say:3:1530204503:0.source_cn: 要不是我不能带着阿娘逃出去，我都想狠狠给他们一拳！
say:3:1530204503:0.male: If I didn't have to worry about my mom, I'd have punched them already!
say:3:1530204503:0.female: If I didn't have to worry about my mom, I'd have punched them already!
